title: CbamExtractionRequest
description:
Arbor -> Nucleos. Text and metadata in.

No blob reference and no bytes. From Phase 2 Arbor owns document-to-text and the storage bucket leaves Nucleos entirely, so a document identifier here is a handle for correlation and audit, never something Nucleos can dereference.

document_id.description: Arbor's Document id. Correlation only — Nucleos cannot fetch it.

document_type.description: Arbor's DocumentType. Nucleos routes on it but does not own the vocabulary.

entity_id.description: Arbor's Entity id. Scopes the request; Nucleos does not resolve it to a tenant of its own.

text.description: Full extracted text of the document.

pages.description: Per-page text. Optional: some sources have no page structure. When present, the extractor can attribute a value to a page.

reporting_period_end.description: ISO 8601 date. Drives certificate expiry and reporting-period checks.

reporting_year.description: Required for the legislated default-value mark-up to be applied. When absent, the default path returns a figure that understates the declarable amount and says so in a warning rather than omitting it silently.
